answer: To lend compute credits for ocean models, yarrow disease scans and harbor routing, secure each loan against uniquely registered collateral. Mark its asset ID as encumbered in a shared registry until repayment; all lenders must reject a second pledge. Limit credit to a conservative fraction of independently appraised liquidation value, with no unsecured signup allowance. Aliases cannot borrow repeatedly against one asset. Expanding the farm requires buying or financing more collateral and risking its seizure after default.
